name: What should I ask a contractor before remodeling a primary bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask before hiring someone to remodel my primary bathroom in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask before hiring someone to remodel my primary bathroom in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a contractor for a primary bathroom remodel, ask detailed questions about permits, waterproofing, scheduling, product selections, payment terms, and how hidden issues are handled. You should also ask who will supervise the job, how often you will get updates, and whether the contractor has recent examples of comparable primary bathroom work in Los Angeles. A strong contractor should be able to explain the process from demolition to final inspection in plain language. They should also provide a written scope so you know what is included and what is not. Pay attention to how they discuss waterproofing, since that is one of the most important parts of a bathroom remodel. Clear answers, a realistic timeline, and organized paperwork are usually better signs than a low price alone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about permits, waterproofing, timeline, payment schedule, hidden-condition pricing, product allowances, inspection handling, and who will manage the job day to day. Also ask to see examples of comparable primary bathroom projects. The best contractor should explain the process clearly and put everything in writing.
